hero_illustrations.title: A household system, not a speculation screen
hero_illustrations.placement: After module introduction, before first teaching section
hero_illustrations.why: Makes Bitcoin as money tangible through household responsibilities rather than price speculation.
hero_illustrations.generation_prompt: Create one finished standalone landscape 16:9 editorial textbook illustration for Bitcoin as Money. Use the supplied single-sig/multisig reference images as the visual canon: continuous fully opaque warm ivory paper (#F5F0E6), subtle paper grain, fine dark-brown ink contours, restrained muted sand, clay, sage and Adriatic navy fills, very small Bitcoin-orange accents. Simple dignified human figures, familiar household objects, crisp spatial relationships, hand-drawn print quality and generous negative space. The atmosphere is calm, practical and thoughtful. Keep the meaningful scene inside the central 80% with ample safe margins. No words, labels, letters, numbers, currency amounts, equations, graph axes or charts anywhere. The Bitcoin symbol may appear once as a small accent if requested. No watermarks, advertising gloss, 3D renders, neon, flying coins, rockets, price tickers, chains around people, fear imagery or product-brand hardware. Do not crop people or important objects. Show a person seated at an ordinary wooden table, thoughtfully arranging a notebook, a modest stack of money tokens, a small house model, a practical tool and a sealed giving envelope. A partner sits beside them as an equal participant. Group the objects into a readable arrangement around the open notebook, suggesting everyday financial order. One small orange Bitcoin symbol on the money container identifies the money being organized. A simple window and a faint Adriatic-blue horizon may sit in the far background, but this is an educational household scene rather than a scenic terrace photograph. The people are looking at their plan, not at the viewer.
hero_illustrations.alt_text: Two people review a household notebook beside money, a home model and a giving envelope.
